title: Quadrotor fault monitor: hybrid digital twin with calibrated alarm thresholds
description: Code and per-flight results for the manuscript "Detecting controller-compensated faults in real quadrotor flights with a hybrid digital twin and calibrated alarm thresholds" (submitted to Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing). The monitor combines a hybrid digital twin, physics-based consistency checks and group-wise MEWMA charts with alarm thresholds calibrated on held-out healthy flight time, evaluated on the real flights of the RflyMAD dataset (Le et al., 2025, https://doi.org/10.1177/02783649241305153). The flight data are not included.
